feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
entry.summary: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

entry.title: A new California law bans child marriage. What's the global outlook on the practice?
entry.summary: The governor of California has signed into law a ban on child marriage. What is the status of other efforts to ban the practice? And do bans prove effective?

entry.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

entry.title: AI data centers: How much are ratepayers on the hook for?
entry.summary: Data centers consume large amounts of power and require upgrading infrastructure. But it's difficult to determine how much residential customers benefit and how much they actually pay for the benefit.

entry.title: Cornell Jane Doe's attorney says she told police in 2024: 'I was raped'
entry.summary: Counter to what a local prosecutor has claimed, the alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR.

entry.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
entry.summary: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

entry.title: She can communicate with ghosts. Here's what she learns from the 'Sad Dead'
entry.summary: My Sad Dead is about an Argentinian doctor who can speak with ghosts. The Spanish-language miniseries blends creepiness, melancholy, sarcastic humor and political anger unlike anything else on TV.

entry.title: Sheryl Crow says she's found 'great liberation' in not chasing the next hit
entry.summary: After selling tens of millions of records worldwide, the singer-songwriter says she's finally aged out of pop music — and she's OK with that. Crow's latest album is Pick You Up.

entry.title: What a Pearly King taught me about Cockney rhyming slang and East London history
entry.summary: In mother-of-pearl suits, the Pearly Kings used to canvass East London for charity. The most famous one, George Major, died in August. A look back on this larger-than-life figure and the Pearly King tradition.

entry.title: Picanha, prices and politics: What Brazil's favorite steak says about the election
entry.summary: President Lula promised Brazilians four years ago they'd be able to afford picanha again. Now, as he seeks another term, the price of the country's favorite cut of beef is telling a different story.
